title: Holtec Pioneer 2 (SMR-300 at Palisades): Approval Email Request for Withholding Determination from Public Disclosure - Revision 1 of Enclosures to the CP2 Application. [['E-Mail', 'Proprietary Information Review']]

documents.text:
From:            Jake Dolecki
To:              Jason Lising; Michael Orenak
Cc:              Michelle Hayes; ext_Miriam_Matthew; ext_Anthony_Konecni
Subject:         [External_Sender] RE: Request for Withholding Determination from Public Disclosure - Revision 1 of Enclosures
                 to the CP2 Application
Date:            Friday, October 23, 2026 3:39:39 PM



Jason,

Confirming receipt. Thank you.

From: Jason Lising <Jason.Lising@nrc.gov>
Sent: Friday, October 23, 2026 1:26 PM
To: Jake Dolecki <J.Dolecki@holtec.com>; Michael Orenak <Michael.Orenak@nrc.gov>
Cc: Michelle Hayes <Michelle.Hayes@nrc.gov>; Miriam Matthew <M.Matthew@holtec.com>;
Anthony Konecni <A.Konecni@holtec.com>
Subject: Request for Withholding Determination from Public Disclosure - Revision 1 of Enclosures to
the CP2 Application


CAUTION: This email came from a source OUTSIDE of Holtec!!
Do not click any links or open any attachments unless you trust the sender
and know the contents to be safe.
Clicking links or opening attachments could lead to infecting your computer
or Holtec’s servers with malicious viruses.
To: Jake Dolecki
Sr. Manager, SMR Licensing and Engineering Programs
Holtec International

By letter subject “Holtec International – Submittal of the Construction Permit Application for
Pioneer Units 1 and 2” dated September 30, 2026 (Agencywide Documents Access and
Management System (ADAMS) Accession No. ML26273A417, part of package
ML26273A416), Holtec submitted an affidavit (ADAMS Accession No. ML26273A414)
requesting that the information contained in the following document be withheld from public
disclosure pursuant to Section 2.390, “Public inspections, exemptions, requests for
withholding,” of Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations (10 CFR):

        Enclosure I: Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Preliminary Safety Analysis Report (Proprietary)
        (ADAMS Accession No.ML26273A418)

The NRC staff reviewed the affidavit and information provided in the letter in accordance
with the requirements of 10 CFR 2.390. Based on the statements in the affidavit, the staff
determined that the information sought to be withheld contains proprietary commercial
information and should be withheld from public disclosure. Therefore, the submitted
information marked as proprietary will be withheld from public disclosure pursuant to
10CFR 2.390(b)(5) and Section 103(b) of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended.

If the basis for withholding this information from public inspection should change in the
 future such that the information could then be made available for public inspection, you
should promptly notify the NRC. You also should understand that the NRC may have cause
to review this determination in the future, for example, if the scope of a Freedom of
Information Act request includes your information. In all review situations, if the NRC makes
a determination adverse to the above, you will be notified in advance of any public
disclosure.

If you have any questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact Michael
Orenak or me.

Thank you,
Jason Lising, Supporting Project Manager

Dockets: 05000616 and 05000617

A. Jason Lising
Project Manager
Office of Advance Reactors
US Nuclear Regulatory Commission
jason.lising@nrc.gov I OWFN/ 6A34




                                      NOTICE OF LEGAL LIABILITY AND DISCLOSURE EXEMPTION

The information contained herein is intended only for the person or entity to which it is addressed (the“recipient”) and may contain confidential
and/or privileged material belonging to Holtec International. If you are not the intended recipient, you must not keep, use, disclose, copy or distribute
this email without the sender’s prior permission in writing. Further, review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of this information in whole or
part for any other purpose by persons outside the recipient's organization is strictly prohibited unless explicit authorization to such effect has been
issued by the sender of this message. Holtec International corporate governance policy expressly prohibits employees from making defamatory or

such un-licentious communications. Holtec International has taken utmost precautions to minimize the risk of transmitting software viruses and asks

transmitted with this communication. If you are the intended recipient and you do not wish to receive similar electronic messages from us in the future,
then please advise the sender to this effect.

Any email communication that is addressed to or originates from any attorney-at-law in Holtec’s or any of its subsidiary’s law departments or
mentions their name in the body of the communication, shall be presumed to be attorney-client privileged and confidential information protected from
disclosure, in whole or in part, under law.
